card.text: Young planet-mass companion 150 au from the VHS 1256-1257 pair, with silicate clouds in its JWST spectrum.

introduction.text: VHS 1256-1257 b is a young planet-mass companion far from its two stars. JWST's spectrum of it shows water, methane, carbon monoxide and silicate clouds.

sources.label: Miles et al. 2023
sources.quote: Water, methane, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, sodium, and potassium are observed

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
